name: Inkmaxx
tagline: Eight arms. Zero days off. Your meme is already printing.
description: Inkmaxx is a meme press that runs in your browser: pick a picture, turn it into a two-ink print, add a caption and stickers, and post it. Run by Maxx, an octopus who never sleeps. $INKMAXX on Solana.

hero.text: Maxx is an octopus who runs a print shop and never sleeps. Give him a picture. He turns it into a meme before you finish the caption.

about.title: Meet Maxx
text: Eight arms. One press. Zero patience.
He prints memes while you look for inspiration. Inspiration is for people with two arms.
He has not slept since the first sheet. He calls it a warm-up.

labels.shareNote: X opens with the text ready. Attach the downloaded sheet to the post yourself.

labels.stickerHint: Tap a sticker to add it. Drag it to move, drag the round handle to resize.
labels.holderNote: Holders print without the corner tag and get the third ink and every sticker. This switch is a preview: the real balance check goes live when the token does.
